scripts.postinstall: pnpm -C app install && pnpm -C app run postinstall
scripts.check: pnpm run check:typecheck && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:format && pnpm run check:knip && pnpm run check:licenses && pnpm run check:proofs && pnpm run check:hub && pnpm run check:go
scripts.check:knip: pnpm -C hub install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline && pnpm -C marketing install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline && app/node_modules/.bin/knip
scripts.check:hub: pnpm -C hub install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline && pnpm -C hub run check
scripts.check:go: go test -C cli ./... && CGO_CFLAGS=-Wno-deprecated-declarations go test -C file-sync ./...
